ActiveBlackout.description: An entry blackout an engine is enforcing now (from state/engine_<account>.json).
ActiveBlackout.title: ActiveBlackout

ActivityEvent.description:
One thing the system did (goldbot/api/activity.py): a shadow trade, an account position or a cost-probe order
opened or closed, or an entry the engine refused. Fields a kind does not have are null.
ActivityEvent.title: ActivityEvent

AgentHealthRow.description: One champion's drift and health (state/drift.json, research/drift.py AgentHealth) with its halt state.
AgentHealthRow.title: AgentHealthRow

AgentRunRow.description: One staff-agent run (data steward, risk officer, journal coach, improvement agent) and its report.
AgentRunRow.title: AgentRunRow

AskReasonView.description:
Why a demo account asks for this entry instead of entering on its own (backlog 103; ADR 0036: demo enters
automatically). `text` is one plain sentence (telegram/approvals.py `ask_reason_text`, the Telegram card's words);
the card prefixes "Asking because: ". `until`: the re-arm lock's end. A terminal-fault card (`terminal_not_demo`: the
terminal says real or contest, shown as real money; `terminal_unknown`: not confirmed yet) has Approve disabled and
the API refuses an approval (sign-off correction 2).
AskReasonView.title: AskReasonView

AttributionView.description: state/attribution.json without its trade rows and calibration (calibration stays on Health).
AttributionView.title: AttributionView

BoardVariant.description:
One arm. Read alone (`pooled` false): its unit's progress is its own. Read pooled: its own count only; the
family's `pooled` progress carries n of N, ETA and the read (`eta_read_date` and `read` are None here).
BoardVariant.title: BoardVariant

CalendarEvent.description: One archived economic-calendar event. Tier 1 (US CPI, NFP, FOMC, PCE) carries its entry-blackout window.
CalendarEvent.title: CalendarEvent

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Logged in. Revokes the user's other sessions.
ChangePasswordRequest.title: ChangePasswordRequest

CodeSignIns.description:
The owner's Telegram-code sign-ins of the last 7 days, newest first (security condition 6): the banner shown
after every sign-in.
CodeSignIns.title: CodeSignIns

CostSplit.title: CostSplit

DayCosts.description:
Today's costs of the closed records, account currency: commission paid (positive), swap (broker sign), spread
where the record keeps it in money (`spread_complete` False: some records keep it only in points).
DayCosts.title: DayCosts

DecidedProposal.description:
A proposal decided in the last few minutes, so its card can show what happened to it.

submitted: decision recorded, the engine applies it (and re-checks the RiskGate) on its next tick;
approved: the order was sent; refused: approved, but not placed: the RiskGate re-check, the MT5 box or the broker
refused the order (see `refusal`; `not_placed` words the MT5 box's and the broker's refusals);
rejected: with its reason code; expired: nobody decided within the window. `decided_channel` ("telegram" |
"dashboard") and `decided_ts` say how and when it was decided, never who (BACKLOG 52: identity is kept in the
auth audit log only).
DecidedProposal.title: DecidedProposal

EmailCodeChallenge.description:
The same shape for every request: an opaque challenge id held only by this browser (a decoy that can never
verify when nothing was sent), how long a code works and when the screen may offer Resend.
EmailCodeChallenge.title: EmailCodeChallenge

EmailCodeRequest.description:
Email + password: the owner gets a 6-digit code on the code channel (Telegram by default; the route names are
from the first, email-only design); every input gets the same answer (ADR 0028).
EmailCodeRequest.title: EmailCodeRequest

EmailLinkRedeemRequest.description: The token from the link's fragment AND a current authenticator code: the link replaces the password only.
EmailLinkRedeemRequest.title: EmailLinkRedeemRequest

EmailLinkRequest.description: Owner only, but the answer is the same generic 200 for every address (nothing can be enumerated).
EmailLinkRequest.title: EmailLinkRequest

detail.default: If this address can use email sign-in, a link is on its way
detail.title: Detail

EngineStrategy.description: An engine strategy or shadow model (not a pre-registered arm): full figures with n and a 90% CI.
EngineStrategy.title: EngineStrategy

EntryBlock.description: One reason this account cannot open a new trade now, in the owner's words (goldbot/api/entry_status.py).
EntryBlock.title: EntryBlock

EntryModeAccount.description:
One reporting engine's entry mode (backlog 92): the account's class and whether it enters on its own or asks.
Real-money accounts always ask (ADR 0036); `ask_reason` is set on demo only.
EntryModeAccount.title: EntryModeAccount

EntryStatus.description:
Can this account take a new trade right now? open: yes; partial: yes, except the strategies named; waiting:
no, and every reason clears by itself; blocked: no, and something needs the owner. Exits never depend on it.
EntryStatus.title: EntryStatus

ForcedPropose.description:
Why a demo account asks for its entries now (ADR 0036: demo normally enters on its own), with the same kinds
and words as the approval card's `ask_reason`: the re-arm lock and the kill switch (read from the risk file), an
unreadable risk file, and what the engine publishes (`ask_reason`: the owner's /mode propose, a terminal that is
not demo, the account's own configuration).
ForcedPropose.title: ForcedPropose

ForgotPasswordRequest.description:
Self-service reset with a current authenticator code; the owner account also needs one of its recovery codes
(spent). The same 403 for an unknown email, a wrong code or a missing recovery code.
ForgotPasswordRequest.title: ForgotPasswordRequest

Headline.description: One collected headline; unscored items (prefiltered out or over the daily cap) have relevance and tags null.
Headline.title: Headline

HealthCheckRow.description: One deterministic health check (goldbot/ops/health.py), evaluated when the view is requested.
HealthCheckRow.title: HealthCheckRow

HypothesisDoc.description: The hypothesis portfolio (docs/research/hypotheses.md), its tables parsed, read-only.
HypothesisDoc.title: HypothesisDoc

JobRow.description: One scheduler job as the dashboard shows it (from state/scheduler.json).
JobRow.title: JobRow

KindDay.description: One kind's figures today on one account.
KindDay.title: KindDay

LabTotal.description:
One lab's sleeve over 7 days: counts and money after costs (None only when a net is unknown or currencies
differ).
LabTotal.title: LabTotal

LimitAccount.description:
One account's risk limits now, from what its engine publishes (state/engine_<account>.json) and the revert in
core.db `limits_state`. Money is in `currency`; percentages are fractions. Null = the engine does not say.
LimitAccount.title: LimitAccount

LimitChange.description:
One limit of one account that moved (goldbot/ops/limits_log.py: core.db ADR 0032 `limits_changes`, diffed per
field, and ADR 0031 `adaptive_changes`). Values are fractions of equity; null = the minimum-lot exception off.
LimitChange.title: LimitChange

LimitsSupervisorView.description:
The supervisor's combined caps (all accounts together; goldbot/risk/supervisor.py), fractions, and (backlog 98)
the same in money: cap x the combined day/week-start equity, used = that start equity - combined equity now
(floating P&L included, a gain uses nothing). Money is null while the supervisor is not reporting, has not summed
the accounts, or the accounts report different currencies (`mixed_currencies`: pounds are never added to
dollars, ADR 0004).
LimitsSupervisorView.title: LimitsSupervisorView

NextTrial.description:
Where the next trials go: the research plan's top-ranked family. `planned_date` stays null until the plan
carries dates (none is invented).
NextTrial.title: NextTrial

NotConfirmed.description:
The dashboard note (API `DecidedProposal.not_confirmed`): a heading word that carries the state, then a
sentence; `tone` picks the colour (amber while unknown: it is not a halt; red only for "Not placed").
NotConfirmed.title: NotConfirmed

NotPlaced.description:
Why an approved order was not placed, in the owner's words. `reason` is a lower-case clause with no final full
stop that reads after either heading ("Refused by the broker." / "Refused by the MT5 box."); None for the
fallback, which names the broker's `code` instead. `next_step` closes the owner notice. `nothing_sent` False only
for the paper broker's duplicate: its first send did go out, so no surface may say "Nothing was sent"
(trading-safety review LOW). `not_sent` (BACKLOG 85): the order never left the engine; `reason` then reads after
"could not be sent: " and `by` says where it failed.
NotPlaced.title: NotPlaced

OpenPosition.description:
One open position (N1): money in the account currency, prices in USD per oz. `floating_pnl` is at the engine's
mid price before spread, commission and swap; None when the engine publishes no price or conversion.
OpenPosition.title: OpenPosition

PlanReservation.description: Trials of the quarter held for the pre-registered queue (research/director.py Reservation).
PlanReservation.title: PlanReservation

PsiHeatmap.description: PSI of the top features (rows) per agent (columns); null where the agent does not use the feature.
PsiHeatmap.title: PsiHeatmap

RankFigures.description:
One row's figures over the window (closed fills with an R, after every cost; voided evidence left out).
Intervals are clustered by (account, opportunity day of the close), t with G-1 df, G = `clusters`.
RankFigures.title: RankFigures

RankVariant.description: One timeframe variant of a family (its arms pooled over accounts), the same columns, never ranked.
RankVariant.title: RankVariant

ReadFigures.description: The read sample's figures, frozen at the read (its first `n` counted trades closed by `read_utc`).
ReadFigures.title: ReadFigures

ReadProgress.description:
One read unit's progress (an arm, or a family read pooled: W1, W2, H-80, H-81; config/arm_reads.yaml). Before
its read: counts, progress, ETA and status only (no money, R, hit rate or rank).
ReadProgress.title: ReadProgress

RecentFigures.description: Net R per trade over the last 7 or 30 opportunity days, with its n.
RecentFigures.title: RecentFigures

RecoveryLoginRequest.description: Owner only: a one-time recovery code in place of the authenticator code.
RecoveryLoginRequest.title: RecoveryLoginRequest

ReliabilityCurve.description: Predicted p (10 equal bins) against the realised target-hit rate of closed, taken shadow trades.
ReliabilityCurve.title: ReliabilityCurve

ResearchCounts.description: Trials by verdict, counted as the trial table reads them (a pass counts only with its cost treatment).
ResearchCounts.title: ResearchCounts

ResearchSummary.description:
Backlog 97 (docs/design/ui-97-98-research-limits.md, "Is research getting us to £50 a day?"): the first card
of the Research screen, from the registry and the plan only. No money projection (needs backlog 33 and
quant-reviewer sign-off); the research-director signs off the wording before release.
ResearchSummary.title: ResearchSummary

ResearchToday.description:
Trials of the current UTC day by verdict (docs/ux/limits-and-tradingview.md C), counted server-side so the day
boundary lives in one place. A pass counts only with its cost treatment (registry.gate_pass_counts).
ResearchToday.title: ResearchToday

ResetRequest.description: Owner-issued one-time link: sets a new password and enrols a new authenticator.
ResetRequest.title: ResetRequest

ResultCell.description:
One attribution cell (research/attribution.py Cell, ADR 0022). Rows are judged on `verdict_adj` at the row's
own bar `t_bar`; "by construction" marks a cell whose sign is set by its definition (exit target / stop).
ResultCell.title: ResultCell

RiskTodayView.description:
Why the risk per trade is what it is today (docs/design/dynamic-limits-2026-10-19.md): the base rate, its
ceiling and the same-day tighten-only factors (each 1 = no cut). Only on an account with dynamic limits on.
RiskTodayView.title: RiskTodayView

SetupResponse.description: The owner's authenticator and 10 one-time recovery codes. Shown once: only their hashes are stored.
SetupResponse.title: SetupResponse

StopRuleView.description:
P6 in fields a screen words itself. status: breached > cant_check > not_started > ok (a breach stays a breach
while part of the record is unreadable: a missing row can only hide more).
StopRuleView.title: StopRuleView

StrategyRiskView.description:
One strategy's (model version's) risk per trade today under dynamic limits (fractions of equity, before the
allocator's multiplier). Null = the engine does not say.
StrategyRiskView.title: StrategyRiskView

StrategyWatch.description: One strategy agent's state in words (N2). Box edges and MFI are not published by the engine yet: None.
StrategyWatch.title: StrategyWatch

StripDay.description: One opportunity day of the strip: net after costs of the rows closed that day.
StripDay.title: StripDay

TodayAccount.description: Today's money for one account (never summed across accounts or modes).
TodayAccount.title: TodayAccount

TradeBars.description:
`bars` (bid prices, USD/oz) from BARS_BEFORE bars before the entry to BARS_AFTER after the exit (now while
open); none stored: `bars` empty and `missing` says so, the levels still given. `stop` is the stop at entry,
`stop_moves` each accepted move after it, in time order.
TradeBars.title: TradeBars

TradeRef.description: One closed trade named by a summary (its best or worst).
TradeRef.title: TradeRef

TradeRow.description:
One trade (opened and closed merged). Money in the account currency, prices USD per oz, times UTC. Closed:
`pnl` is net of every cost and `gross` = pnl + costs.total (to the penny). Open: `pnl_now` at the engine's mid
price from the fill (the entry spread is inside it).
TradeRow.title: TradeRow

TradeStats.description: Closed trades of the period, and the trades open now (open is the same in every period).
TradeStats.title: TradeStats

TradeTotals.description:
The filter's totals over every matching row (not only the page), equal to the sum of those rows. Money is None
only when currencies differ (never summed) or, for the net, when a closed trade's net is unknown.
TradeTotals.title: TradeTotals

TradesSummary.description:
Your account's closed trades over the last `days` opportunity days (ops/report_days.py, the monthly report's
day and P&L basis: net rows in the account currency only; other rows are counted and flagged, never summed).
TradesSummary.title: TradesSummary

TrialRow.description:
One research-registry trial (state/research_registry.jsonl). R figures are the rule's own expectancy over
every candidate: gross on mid prices, net of every cost.
TrialRow.title: TrialRow

TvIndicatorStatus.description: One TradingView indicator at one timeframe: arrival of its bar alerts (counts only, never plotted values).
TvIndicatorStatus.title: TvIndicatorStatus

TvStatusView.description:
The TradingView card (docs/ux/limits-and-tradingview.md B). TradingView is an optional second feed and never
stops trading, so no state here is a failure: the screen shows expired, unknown and stale in amber.
TvStatusView.title: TvStatusView

UserRef.description: A user for reset-link, disable, enable and revoke-sessions.
UserRef.title: UserRef

VetoTestView.description: Welch's two-sample t-test of mean R, approved minus rejected (telegram/automode.py VetoTest).
VetoTestView.title: VetoTestView

schema.title: Response Agent Runs Api Agent Runs Get

get.description:
The owner's Telegram-code sign-ins of the last 7 days (time, coarse network), for the banner shown after
every sign-in with its one-tap "sign out everywhere".

post.description:
Owner only. A challenge for every input (a decoy unless the password is right, the address is the owner's
and mail is ready); 403 only while the sign-in lockout holds, as for sign-in.
A new code for this challenge (only the newest works): not before resend_after_s; the same shape always.

The challenge and its code: a 12 h owner session (method email_code). A Telegram-code sign-in is audited
`tg_code_login` and listed in the owner's banner (condition 6); the mail channel also mails a notice. The
delivered message is deleted once the code is used or burned.
Owner only, the same generic 200 for every address, configured or not (AuthStore.request_email_link).

The link's token AND a current authenticator code (the link replaces the password, not the second factor).
A success also emails the owner a sign-in notice (ADR 0013).

schema.title: Response Limits Changes Api Limits Changes Get

get.description:
Proposals decided in the last 10 minutes (newest first), so a decided card says what happened to it: by
channel and time only, never who (BACKLOG 52). An approval whose order is not confirmed yet stays listed until
it resolves (BACKLOG 72: the dashboard never drops an unanswered order).

schema.title: Response Recent Proposals Api Proposals Recent Get
Response Trades Summary Api Trades Summary Get
